parameter.tooltip.gravity_mps2: Navigation gravity subtraction only; calibration, alignment and sensor conversion retain their separate platform gravity.
parameter.tooltip.process_accel_std: This parameter constructs prediction-stage process noise Q and represents unmodelled acceleration error in inertial prediction. It is neither live GNSS accuracy nor simply static IMU white noise.
parameter.tooltip.nis_threshold: NIS consistency-gating threshold; the soft threshold applies weighting and the hard threshold rejects the measurement.
parameter.tooltip.nis_max_r_scale: Actual dimensionless cap already used by soft gating; not a multiplier of a hidden default.
